from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Parsed information from a single legal judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the legal document")
    case_cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action identified in the document (e.g., 行政处罚，政府信息公开)")
    document_subtype: str | None = Field(description="The specific subtype of the document found in the text (e.g., 判决书，裁定书)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
